# Induduzo Funeral Home

> Family-run funeral home in Pietermaritzburg, KwaZulu-Natal, serving local families and the wider Midlands since the 1980s. The official website is https://induduzo.co.za/.

Induduzo Funeral Home provides funeral arrangements, funeral plans, repatriations, pre-planning, exhumations, caskets and related products. The public site is available in English and isiZulu. For current services and plan terms, use the linked pages rather than relying on this summary.

## Official pages

- [Home](https://induduzo.co.za/): Overview and contact options.
- [About](https://induduzo.co.za/about): Company history and values.
- [Services](https://induduzo.co.za/services): Funeral services and related offerings.
- [Plans](https://induduzo.co.za/join): Current funeral plan details.
- [Contact](https://induduzo.co.za/contact): Official phone numbers, WhatsApp links, email and location.
- [Founder](https://induduzo.co.za/founder): Founder story.

## Contact and location

Induduzo Funeral Home is at Edendale Main Road, Kwadaya, Pietermaritzburg, KwaZulu-Natal 3201. Call +27 79 751 0648 or +27 82 954 9241, or email Info@induduzo.co.za. For directions and public reviews, see the Google Maps link on the official contact page.

## Notes

This file is a concise guide to the public website. It is not a source of private customer or staff information. Refer visitors to the official pages for current prices, eligibility and service details.
